 Paris Saint Germain vs. Estac Troyes - Head-to-head record
 The history between Paris Saint Germain and Estac Troyes reveals a clear dominance by the Parisian team. In their last ten encounters, Paris Saint Germain secured nine wins, while Estac Troyes managed no victories . One match concluded in a draw, highlighting the one-sided nature of these recent meetings.
 Paris Saint Germain’s superiority is evident in past results, including a significant 9-0 triumph in 2016. The Paris Saint Germain vs. Estac Troyes fixture has consistently shown the capital club’s strength, often scoring multiple goals in these encounters. This trend clearly illustrates the difficult challenge ahead for the visitors.
 The sole instance where Estac Troyes earned a point was a 2-2 draw at the Parc des Princes in May 2022. This result indicates that even at home, Paris Saint Germain are not always invincible. It offers a slight hope for Troyes against a formidable opponent.

 Paris Saint Germain - Looking simply unstoppable
 Here we will analyse Paris Saint Germain’s current situation. We will highlight their momentum and recent performances leading up to this match. We will also examine player statistics and any injury updates.
 Recent form
 Paris Saint Germain enters this match in scintillating form. They currently sit top of the Ligue 1 table with 20 points from nine games, having secured six wins, two draws, and just one loss. This impressive run includes dominant UEFA Champions League victories against European giants like Barcelona and Manchester City.
 Their attack has been particularly devastating, scoring 21 goals and conceding 10 in the Ligue 1 . They recently put six past Villarreal in the Champions League and netted five against Le Havre in their last league outing. Attacker Ferran Torres is a constant threat, having already contributed four goals this season, while defenders Achraf Hakimi and Marquinhos have also found the back of the net three times each.
 Playing at their Parc des Princes home, where they have won two of three league games, PSG’s confidence will be high. With no reported injuries, they can field their strongest lineup, which makes the task for Estac Troyes seem almost insurmountable.

 Estac Troyes - Hoping to build momentum
 Now, let’s look at Estac Troyes’ situation. We will analyse their current form, recent results, and the standout players for their trip to Paris.
 Recent form
 Estac Troyes sit 16th in the Ligue 1 table with just eight points from nine matches. Their campaign has been a struggle, recording only two wins, two draws, and five losses. The team’s issues are evident, with only seven goals scored and 16 conceded.
 Despite their struggles, the visitors show recent signs of improvement in the league. They are unbeaten in their last two Ligue 1 outings, securing a 2-0 win against Le Mans and a goalless draw at Toulouse. However, their away form remains a concern, with only one win from four matches on the road this season.
 Troyes lack a prolific goalscorer, as several players, including Mouhamed Diop and Antoine Mille, have only one goal each. Importantly, they have a fully fit squad for this encounter, offering their best chance to compete. Nevertheless, facing leaders Paris Saint Germain at the Parc des Princes presents a formidable challenge.

 Predictions for Paris Saint Germain vs. Estac Troyes - PSG to dominate
 Paris Saint Germain are in unstoppable form, winning their last games and scoring freely. Given their tendency to start matches strongly at home, it is highly probable that Paris Saint Germain will be winning at half-time.
 Estac Troyes have struggled defensively on the road, conceding many goals this season. Facing PSG’s potent attack, which recently scored five and six in matches, this game could easily feature over 3.5 goals in total.
 The vast gap in quality and current form points towards a one-sided affair at the Parc des Princes. Therefore, our main prediction is for a comfortable home victory by a significant margin, backing Paris Saint Germain to win with a ‘-2.5 Asian Handicap’ .
